parsed.rationale: Both `WXUISampleApp.body` (in `Shared/WXUI/Examples/WXUISampleApp/Sources/WXUISampleApp.swift`) and `PlayerHeaderViewApp.body` (in `Shared/PlayerHeaderView/PlayerHeaderViewApp/PlayerHeaderViewApp.swift`) are SwiftUI `App` entry-point `body` computed properties. These are boilerplate entry points required by the SwiftUI `App` protocol for each standalone preview/sample application target; their structural identity is an artifact of the protocol requirement, not shared domain logic. The `fields_or_signature` list is empty for both, meaning there is no extractable shared implementation to consolidate. Merging or abstracting these would couple two independent app targets without any meaningful reduction in complexity.
